description:
A well-presented one bedroom apartment located in a central position moments from the seafront and many of the popular attractions. The property is offered to the market with no onward chain and is in good condition with potential for some minor refurbishments if desired, and would ideally suit first time buyers looking to get onto the property ladder or investors looking for a project to re-sell or expand their rental portfolio.

The property is accessed via a secure fob entry system, comprising an entrance hall with a storage cupboard, a bright and spacious lounge/diner, a well-appointed kitchen with appliances, a spacious double bedroom with a cupboard/wardrobe and a dressing area, and a contemporary shower room suite. There is parking available at a cost of £5 per week.

There is also another one bedroom apartment in the block available for sale via the same vendor through Express Estate Agency, which can be found here:   #/?channel=RES_BUY

Early viewing is highly recommended due to the property being realistically priced.

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION:

Council Tax Band: A

Local Authority: Blackpool

Lease Term: 125 years from 1 January 2005

Ground Rent & Service Charges: £232 Per Month plus £62.50 to go to the freeholder 

*This information is based on information obtained via Land Registry and/or the vendor at the point of listing and will therefore need to be confirmed by a solicitor.
